name: origin-protocol-observatory
description: A neutral, reproducible evidence system for Bitcoin protocol behavior, software provenance, and rule-change transparency.

scripts.verify: node cli/origin.mjs verify-report data/reports/origin-bitcoin-core-fixture.json && node cli/origin.mjs verify-log data/log/origin-log.json && node --test tests/v1.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run seed && npm test && npm run export:single
scripts.check: node --check server/index.mjs && node --check cli/origin.mjs && node --check cli/origin-v1.mjs && node --check lib/*.mjs && node --check scripts/*.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify
